h: NELFUND reviewing ₦20,000 monthly upkeep for students
p: The Nigerian Education Loan Fund says it is reviewing the ₦20,000 monthly upkeep allowance it pays to student beneficiaries, citing economic pressures. MD Akin Sawyer said any increase must be carefully considered.
body: The Nigerian Education Loan Fund (NELFUND) is considering an increase to the ₦20,000 monthly upkeep allowance it pays to student beneficiaries.
NELFUND's Managing Director, Akin Sawyer, said in a television interview on Friday, 20 November 2026, that the allowance was being reviewed in light of the economic pressures facing students.
He said the matter is under constant review, but stressed that any increase would need careful consideration.
NELFUND, set up under President Bola Tinubu's administration, gives loans to students in tertiary institutions and pays a monthly upkeep allowance to beneficiaries.
more: The allowance is currently ₦20,000 a month.
NELFUND says it is under review.
Any increase must be carefully considered.
